jobs_spec_basis: Careers site tRPC API /api/trpc/job.getJobs (batch=1, paged, limit 20) lists all jobs
evidence: Careers tRPC API 2026-10-19 (616 jobs, 60 US): US software roles are Sr Staff, Principal or Firmware Principal. Only US new-grad posting is a DFT Engineer (hardware, 2026-10-19). 2027 campus software roles are in Taiwan, Singapore, Sweden.
